spacing.rhythm: 8px operational rhythm with larger editorial intervals

radius.rule: print-like, never pill-shaped except status dots

motion.rule: one active signature effect per surface

must: Preserve all game mechanics, Supabase RPCs and persisted session shapes
Maintain 44px touch targets, visible focus and keyboard navigation
Support Table, Classroom, Contrast and reduced-motion modes
Keep one Canvas or WebGL renderer active at a time
Keep all critical data and controls in semantic DOM
avoid: Generic glass cards and decorative gradients
Copying reference websites or paid 21st component code

decisions.decision: Use the manufacturer box art as a live Canvas2D dither hero
decisions.reason: It is product-native and same-origin, unlike a stock portrait.

decisions.decision: Use LiquidButton once and MetalButton only for physical game commitments
decisions.reason: Tactility should communicate importance rather than become decoration.

decisions.decision: Recompose mobile layouts instead of scaling desktop compositions
decisions.reason: Projection and tabletop density do not translate directly to phones.

decisions.decision: Main contains source; GitHub Actions deploys dist
decisions.reason: Remove source/deploy drift while preserving the exact Pages URL.

evidence: Live site desktop and mobile review on 2026-07-28
21st component 20779 All about the Benjamins used as visual reference only
Current digital-table design handoff and prior browser QA
